title: Final Energy Estimate
description: Essential Criteria: The final estimate for the ground state energy using the uncertainty principle must be correctly derived and presented.

title: Bohr-Sommerfeld Result
description: Essential Criteria: The application of the Bohr-Sommerfeld quantization rule must yield the correct expression for the ground state energy.

title: Variational Principle
description: Essential Criteria: The variational principle must be applied correctly with a suitable trial wave function to find the ground state energy.

title: Exact Solution
description: Essential Criteria: The exact solution for the energy eigenvalue and eigenfunction must be derived accurately from the Schrödinger equation.

title: Effective Potential
description: Essential Criteria: The effective potential for nonzero angular momentum states must be correctly stated.

title: Uncertainty Principle Use
description: Important Criteria: The application of the uncertainty principle must include correct reasoning and assumptions about momentum and position.

title: Quantization Conditions
description: Important Criteria: The conditions for quantization in the Bohr-Sommerfeld approach must be clearly articulated and applied.

title: Trial Wave Function Choice
description: Important Criteria: The choice of trial wave function in the variational method should be justified and relevant to the problem.

title: Common Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: Missing factors or incorrect signs in the energy expressions or equations will lead to significant deductions.

title: Unit Consistency
description: Pitfall Criteria: Any inconsistencies in units throughout the calculations will result in deductions.
